messages.speaker: Bexley
messages.text: "Everyone, gather round the fire. We cross the ridge at first light."

messages.speaker: Brannock
messages.text: Brannock stamps snow off his boots. "The ridge path is iced over past the second cairn."

messages.speaker: Odessa
messages.text: "Then we rope up at the cairn and go slow," Odessa says to the group.

messages.speaker: Perrin
messages.text: Perrin leans toward Teodor and whispers, "I left the spare rope at the last camp."

messages.speaker: Teodor
messages.text: "Then we share mine," Teodor answers aloud, patting the coil on his pack.

messages.speaker: Bexley
messages.text: "How many days of food do we have left?"

messages.speaker: Odessa
messages.text: Odessa counts the sacks. "Four days if nobody gets greedy."

messages.speaker: Brannock
messages.text: Brannock murmurs to Odessa alone, "Make it three. I saw tracks near the stores last night."

messages.speaker: Odessa
messages.text: Odessa nods once and says nothing to the others.

messages.speaker: Teodor
messages.text: Teodor raises his voice for everyone: "The weather turns by noon tomorrow." Then, lower, only to Perrin: "And my knee will not last the descent."

messages.speaker: Perrin
messages.text: "We could wait a day at the hut," Perrin offers.

messages.speaker: Bexley
messages.text: "No waiting. The pass closes when the snow comes."

messages.speaker: Brannock
messages.text: Brannock hands over a folded map. "Mark the hut on this, just in case."

messages.speaker: Odessa
messages.text: Odessa catches Brannock by the sleeve and whispers, "The tracks were boots, not wolves."

messages.speaker: Teodor
messages.text: Teodor mutters something into his scarf.

messages.speaker: Perrin
messages.text: Perrin stirs the pot. "Supper is ready, such as it is."

messages.speaker: Brannock
messages.text: Brannock signs to Teodor with two fingers: watch the north tree line.

messages.speaker: Teodor
messages.text: "Understood," Teodor says, loud enough for all, and moves to the edge of camp.

messages.speaker: Bexley
messages.text: "Who takes first watch?"

messages.speaker: Odessa
messages.text: "I will. Wake Perrin at midnight."

messages.speaker: Perrin
messages.text: Perrin yawns. "Fine by me, I am exhausted." He slips Odessa a note that reads: the stores were opened from inside.

messages.speaker: Teodor
messages.text: Teodor tells Brannock quietly, "I counted the sacks myself. One is missing."

messages.speaker: Bexley
messages.text: "Teodor has gone ahead to scout. The three of you, with me."

messages.speaker: Brannock
messages.text: "The wind is picking up from the west," Brannock calls out.

messages.speaker: Odessa
messages.text: Odessa leans in to Perrin: "Do you trust Teodor with the map?"

messages.speaker: Perrin
messages.text: Perrin answers her under his breath, "Less than I did yesterday."

messages.speaker: Bexley
messages.text: "Keep moving. We talk at the hut."

messages.speaker: Brannock
messages.text: Brannock points at the slope ahead. "Avalanche scar. Single file from here."

messages.speaker: Odessa
messages.text: Odessa whispers to Brannock so Perrin cannot hear, "If he took the sack, he is hiding it in his bedroll."

messages.speaker: Perrin
messages.text: "I can hear you two muttering," Perrin says with a crooked smile.

messages.speaker: Bexley
messages.text: "Enough. Eyes on the trail."

messages.speaker: Brannock
messages.text: Brannock laughs it off. "Just the cold talking." He mouths a single word to Odessa: later.

messages.speaker: Perrin
messages.text: Perrin slips on the ice and catches himself on an outstretched arm.

messages.speaker: Odessa
messages.text: "Careful. One broken leg and we are finished," Odessa warns everyone.

messages.speaker: Bexley
messages.text: Bexley murmurs to Perrin, "Stay close to me on the descent."

messages.speaker: Perrin
messages.text: "Hut in sight!" Perrin shouts.

messages.speaker: Brannock
messages.text: Brannock kicks the hut door open and checks inside. "Empty. Dry wood, too."

messages.speaker: Odessa
messages.text: Odessa says something by the door that the wind carries off.

messages.speaker: Bexley
messages.text: "Fire first, then food, then we talk."

messages.speaker: Perrin
messages.text: Perrin builds the fire while the others unpack.

messages.speaker: Odessa
messages.text: Odessa tells Bexley alone by the woodpile, "I think Teodor is honest. Someone wants us to doubt him."

messages.speaker: Brannock
messages.text: "Teodor should be back before dark," Brannock says to everyone.

messages.speaker: Perrin
messages.text: Perrin pulls Brannock aside: "If he is not back by dark, we go without him."

messages.speaker: Bexley
messages.text: "Nobody goes anywhere without everyone. That is final."
